title: AllocationTemplateDetails
description: Full template representation for the details page and mutation responses

total_descendant_count.description: Number of live direct and transitive linked descendants

strategy_entry_count.description: Number of strategy entries across the published configuration's menus

materialized_config.description: The frozen published snapshot every reader consumes

overrides.description: The published override set; null for standalone templates

conflict_view.description: Present only while the template needs resolution

sleeve_targets.description: The sleeves an account assigned to the published configuration would get, one per funded strategy in tree order, before any account overrides. Null when the configuration has unset weights and cannot be assigned.

AllocationTemplateConfig.description: A fully materialized template tree. The document root is itself a node.
AllocationTemplateConfig.title: AllocationTemplateConfig

AllocationTemplateConflict.description: A validation or resolution conflict identifying a failing node (and optionally a menu entry)

node_id.description: The ID of the node the conflict is attached to

strategy_id.description: The menu entry the conflict is attached to, when applicable

AllocationTemplateConflict.title: AllocationTemplateConflict

AllocationTemplateConflictView.description: The derived conflict state, recomputed on demand: the published overrides re-resolved against the base's current published version (best effort), with the failing nodes flagged. Seeds the Resolve builder session.
AllocationTemplateConflictView.title: AllocationTemplateConflictView

ancestors.description: The ancestor chain ordered family root first, direct base last

children.description: Live templates directly linked to this one

AllocationTemplateNode.description: A node in the template tree. It holds either child nodes or a strategy menu, never both; cash holds neither. A model_category is a section defined by strategy tags — those tags filter which strategies show up in menus under it, and at least one is required. Ordinary sections and cash must not carry tags.

id.description: Stable node id ('aatn_' ULID). Minted server-side for new nodes: omit or send empty on creation, keep it verbatim on later publishes - child overrides are keyed by it.

name.description: Display name; the root node may have an empty name

kind.description: What this node is. A node is a free-text section; a model_category is a section defined by strategy tags; cash is the funding buffer.

relative_weight.description: The node's share of its parent as a decimal string (never a number). Null means unset; the root carries an implicit 100% and keeps this null.

min_weight.description: Optional lower range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

max_weight.description: Optional upper range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

tag_ids.description: Strategy tag ids from the tags service. Required on a model_category (at least one). Must be omitted or empty on ordinary sections and cash. A nested model_category cannot reuse a tag already set by an ancestor.

children.description: Child nodes; mutually exclusive with strategies

strategies.description: The leaf node's strategy menu; mutually exclusive with children

AllocationTemplateNode.title: AllocationTemplateNode

AllocationTemplateOverrides.description: A linked template's delta against its base, keyed by stable node id. Field semantics are tri-state and load-bearing: an absent field inherits from the base, an explicit null is an unset/clear override, a value is an override. Per node: relative_weight/min_weight/max_weight plus a strategies map keyed by strategy id with relative_weight/min_weight/max_weight (value overrides), added (child-added entry), and removed (child-removed base entry). Typed loosely so absent and null survive the wire.
AllocationTemplateOverrides.title: AllocationTemplateOverrides

AllocationTemplateSleeveTarget.description: One funded strategy entry of the configuration, with its weights multiplied down the tree. Shares are percents of the account's managed value as decimal strings (never numbers).

absolute_min.description: The lowest share the sleeve may drift to; 0 when unconstrained

absolute_max.description: The highest share the sleeve may drift to; 100 when unconstrained

AllocationTemplateSleeveTarget.title: AllocationTemplateSleeveTarget

AllocationTemplateStrategyEntry.description: A reference from a leaf node's menu to an existing strategy, with a relative weight. A 0% weight means the strategy is approved for selection but not allocated by default.

strategy_id.description: The ID of the referenced strategy

relative_weight.description: The entry's share of its menu as a decimal string (never a number). Null means unset.

min_weight.description: Optional lower range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

max_weight.description: Optional upper range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

AllocationTemplateStrategyEntry.title: AllocationTemplateStrategyEntry

AllocationTemplateSummary.description: Summary representation used by list rows and lineage entries

template_type.description: Whether the template owns its tree or inherits from a base

base_template_id.description: The base template a linked template inherits from

needs_resolution.description: True when the published overrides no longer validate against the base's current published version

is_incomplete.description: True when at least one category or strategy in the template has no weight set. An incomplete template can still be the base for linked templates, but it cannot be assigned to accounts until every weight is filled in.

direct_descendant_count.description: Number of live templates directly linked to this one

current_version_id.description: The ID of the currently published version

created_by.description: The user who created the template

updated_by.description: The user who last updated the template

AllocationTemplateSummary.title: AllocationTemplateSummary

display_name.description: The display name of the user
